name: Forced Disarmament

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you rely on Menethil Harbor as a vital lifeline across the Great Sea. Disarming hostile clans nearby is an urgent concern.
As a dwarf, you know Ironforge defenders garrison Menethil Keep. They work to secure Khaz Modan’s perimeter from old enemies entrenched in the marshes.
As an orc, you know the Dragonmaw are a splintered, unrepentant remnant of the Old Horde. Their violent warmongering sets them apart from the new Horde leadership in Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Captain Stoutfist is a dwarven military officer at Menethil Keep. He is responsible for defending Menethil Harbor and the surrounding Wetlands. With hostile beasts, Dark Iron saboteurs, and the Dragonmaw clan pressing nearby, he directs soldiers and adventurers to suppress threats before the port’s supply lines and harbor facilities are overrun.

The Dragonmaw clan is gathering weapons at its retreat to arm new fighters. Left unchecked, its warbands could overwhelm local Alliance defenses and endanger Menethil Harbor. Taking thirty bundles hinders their preparations and keeps more orc soldiers from taking the field.
faq.q: Why do the Dragonmaw need to be disarmed?

faq.answer: Dragonmaw Retreat is a Dragonmaw orc encampment in the Wetlands, eastward toward the mountains beyond Menethil Harbor. The clan stores weapons and gathers forces there, and stages attacks on travelers in the marshes. You venture into the heart of the camp to recover the stockpiled weapons.

Dragonmaw Armaments are bundles of martial gear, blades, and equipment the Dragonmaw clan forged or stole for its warriors. They represent the clan’s immediate military strength in the region. Captain Stoutfist asks you to confiscate thirty bundles and bring them to Menethil Keep for evaluation and disposal.

No. The Dragonmaw clan in the Wetlands is an independent, hostile faction that does not answer to Warchief Thrall. Still loyal to its old ways after the Second War, the clan deeply hates the Alliance and refuses peaceful overtures. Alliance defenders and independent travelers alike treat the Dragonmaw as lethal adversaries.
faq.q: Is the Dragonmaw clan part of the Horde in 25 ADP?

faq.answer: Menethil Keep is the administrative and military fortress that safeguards Menethil Harbor, the Alliance’s principal maritime hub in Khaz Modan. Marsh beasts and aggressive orcs plague the wetlands around the harbor. Captain Stoutfist cannot let a heavily armed camp like Dragonmaw Retreat thrive near the kingdom’s docks and trade routes.
faq.q: Why is Menethil Keep concerned with the Dragonmaw?

sections.body: In the Wetlands, the Dragonmaw clan has stored a troubling number of weapons at Dragonmaw Retreat. Left there, they could arm fresh bands of warriors for raids on nearby settlements. Taking the weapons weakens the orcs’ preparations before their warbands can take the field.
sections.title: An Armory in the Marshes

sections.body: Menethil Harbor links Khaz Modan and Stormwind to the sea, making it a vital port. Nearby military buildup puts it in danger. Captain Stoutfist directs the harbor’s defenses from Menethil Keep and watches hostile clans and beasts draw near. Recovering thirty sets of Dragonmaw armaments deprives the orcs of weapons and gives the dwarven garrison a measure of their readiness.
sections.title: Securing the Coastal Port

summary: At Dragonmaw Retreat, you seize thirty bundles of weapons from hostile orcs for Captain Stoutfist. Their loss keeps the clan from arming more soldiers for future raids. You carry the gear to Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Keep, helping protect the region’s vital harbor.
